  • Strong commercial judgement and the ability to engage credibly with senior trading and executive stakeholders
  • The ability to distinguish genuinely valuable AI opportunities from technology-led experimentation
  • Experience contributing to or leading complex transformation, strategy or operating-model engagements
  • Strong leadership, communication and team-development skills
  • Deep expertise in either commodities and energy trading or data, analytics and AI, together with a working understanding of, or some practical exposure to, the other discipline and the commitment to continue building depth across both

If your primary background is in commodities and trading, you will ideally bring

  • Deep expertise in at least one commodity, such as Power, Gas, LNG, Oil, Metals or Environmental Products
  • A strong understanding of trading, portfolio management, risk, physical flows, scheduling, optimisation and/or commercial operations
  • Familiarity with ETRM/CTRM platforms and the wider trading technology and data ecosystems
  • Some experience of using, sponsoring or shaping data, analytics, automation or AI initiatives within a trading or commercial environment, together with an understanding of how these capabilities can improve trading decisions, processes and outcomes

If your primary background is in data, analytics and AI, you will ideally bring

  • An understanding of the opportunities and limitations of GenAI, LLMs, AI agents and decision-support tools, and how they apply in a trading environment

description: Ben jij een Manager of Senior Manager met een focus op Commercial Excellence en ben jij klaar voor de volgende stap? Ben je op zoek naar een club waar ondernemerschap en groei centraal staan? Mis je de ruimte om echt impact te maken in je huidige rol? Spreekt groei en het meewerken aan innovatieve ontwikkelingen je aan? Dan is dit dé vacature voor jou! Met meer dan 900 getalenteerde collega's die echt verandering en uitdagingen omarmen, hebben we een unieke "high-daring", "high-caring" cultuur gecreëerd, die buitengewone mensen aantrekt en hen inspireert om de grenzen voor zichzelf en onze klanten te verleggen. Wij geloven dat de optimale werkomgeving gelijkwaardig is en stellen duidelijke doelen om gendergelijkheid te versnellen. Wat ga je doen? Als Senior Manager Retail & Products ben je dé gesprekspartner voor bestuurders in de retail, FMCG, (maak)industrie, logistiek en groothandel die hun commerciële organisatie naar een hoger niveau willen tillen: meer groei uit dezelfde markt, de juiste prijs per klant, kanaal en moment, en een salesorganisatie die structureel wint. Van uiteenlopende projecten gefocust op het aangescherpen van groeistrategieën tot Smart Pricing & Revenue Management en Sales Excellence met de bijbehorende capabilities: jij zet de koers uit en zorgt dat die landt. Daarvoor werk je met multidisciplinaire teams uit strategieconsulting, data & AI, technologie en organisatorische en digitale transformatie. Zo combineer je scherpe commerciële analyses met de data, tools en verandering die nodig zijn om de groei ook echt te realiseren. Als senior manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor grote klanttrajecten en een vertrouwde sparringpartner op C-level. Je bouwt accounts uit, ziet de volgende vraag van de klant al aankomen en zet die om in nieuwe opdrachten. Daarbij krijg je alle vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid, zowel voor het project als voor de accountontwikkeling. Daarnaast bouw je mee aan het Retail & Products-team zelf: je ontwikkelt onze Commercial Excellence-proposities, helpt collega’s groeien en bent een drijvende kracht achter onze verdere gezamenlijke groei. Wat betekent dit voor jou? Je komt te werken bij een Great Place to Work met zeer tevreden medewerkers en klanten (NPS > 65; ruim boven het marktgemiddelde). Bovendien realiseren we groei met dubbele cijfers en hebben we onze blik stevig gericht op verdere uitbreiding. We zitten met onze eigen succesvolle transformatie midden in een spannend avontuur! Waarom zou je er geen deel van uitmaken? Wat zeggen je toekomstige collega's? “IG&H is echt anders dan andere strategieconsultants. Wij hebben een warme benadering en een zorgzame cultuur. De scherpte van IG&H-consultants en de state-of-the-art digitale oplossingen, die leiden tot daadwerkelijke resultaten bij onze klanten, halen het beste in mij naar boven – elke dag.” Cazijn Langeler – Managing Director Retail & Products “De huidige groeifase van IG&H biedt een geweldige kans om mezelf te ontwikkelen op een breed spectrum aan vaardigheden, omringd en ondersteund door heel veel intelligente mensen.” Guus Boonstra – Manager Retail & Products Wat neem jij mee? · Afgeronde universitaire master. · Minimaal 8 jaar relevante werkervaring, waarvan meerdere jaren in strategie en digital consulting. · Sterke management- en communicatievaardigheden; je weet stakeholders te verbinden en C-levelklanten te activeren. · Sterk analytisch vermogen en conceptueel denken. · Diepgaande kennis van Commercial Excellence. · Een groot netwerk in de Retail, Industriële, Logistieke, Groothandel en/of FMCG-sector. · Je ontwikkelt geavanceerde businessmodellen en langetermijnstrategieën. · Ondernemende instelling en drive om verandering en groei te realiseren – zowel bij onze klanten als binnen onze eigen organisatie. Wat we jou bieden: · Werken bij een Great Place to Work met een prettige werksfeer en enthousiaste collega's die je ondersteunen. · Een mooie kans om een actieve bijdrage te leveren aan de verdere groei van de organisatie. · Direct een vast contract voor onbepaalde tijd. · Uitstekend salaris en arbeidsvoorwaarden. · Auto van de zaak / goede mobiliteitsregeling. · Een fulltime dienstverband, maar indien gewenst ook de mogelijkheid om (al dan niet tijdelijk) parttime te werken (80%), minimaal 4 dagen per week. · Wij ondersteunen incidenteel werken in het buitenland voor maximaal 4 weken per jaar. · 25 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om er meer op te nemen. · De mogelijkheid om na 3 jaar dienstverband een sabbatical op te nemen. · IG&H faciliteert een Healthy Human-programma, waarbij je begeleiding krijgt bij alle aanpassingen in het leven, zoals het krijgen van een kind of het verzorgen van een ziek familielid. · Royale bonusregeling. · En nog veel meer, waar we je graag meer over vertellen. Waarom IG&H? IG&H helpt toonaangevende bedrijven in de sectoren Gezondheid, Retail & Products en Financial Services te transformeren. Samen met onze technologiepartners van wereldklasse helpen we onze klanten vooruit en blijven we relevant. Met inzichtelijk advies, mooie designs en ongeëvenaarde digitale platforms. Onze uitzonderlijke resultaten komen voort uit het succesvol op elkaar afstemmen van mensen, bedrijfsprocessen en technologie. Met meer dan 900 getalenteerde collega's in de verschillende teams, die verandering en uitdagingen oprecht omarmen, hebben we een unieke, zeer gedurfde en zorgzame cultuur gecreëerd. We trekken bijzondere mensen aan en inspireren hen om de grenzen te verleggen voor zichzelf en onze klanten. Ben je enthousiast? Voor meer informatie kun je contact opnemen met één van onze recruiters via We willen dat onze werknemers de diversiteit van de maatschappij weerspiegelen. We werken samen met een opmerkelijke mix van talenten, persoonlijkheden en culturen. IG&H is er trots op een werkgever te zijn die gelijke kansen biedt. Alle gekwalificeerde sollicitanten worden in aanmerking genomen voor een baan, ongeacht hun afkomst, religie, geslacht, genderexpressie, seksuele geaardheid, handicap of leeftijd. We geven om individualiteit! Maar het allerbelangrijkste is dat we allemaal trots zijn op onze prestaties bij onze klanten en daarom zijn we niet voor niets een Great Place to Work. description: Marketing von A bis Z. Verantwortung übernehmen. Gemeinsam etwas bewegen. Vom Newsletter über die Website bis zum gebrandeten Kugelschreiber. Von der Versandaktion bis zur eigenen Messe mit über 3.000 Besuchern und mehr als 180 Ausstellern: Bei uns entsteht Marketing von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung im eigenen Team. Du hast Lust auf genau diese Vielfalt? Du denkst strategisch, packst operativ mit an und möchtest nicht nur Konzepte entwickeln, sondern selbst etwas bewegen? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig! Als (Senior) Marketing Manager (m/w/d) gestaltest Du unsere externe Kommunikation und Markenpräsenz aktiv mit. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt im E-Mail-Marketing, der zielgruppengerechten Kommunikation sowie der Weiterentwicklung unserer CRM- und Marketing-Automation-Prozesse. Dabei übernimmst Du Verantwortung, triffst Entscheidungen und setzt Projekte eigenständig um. Gemeinsam im Team entwickelst Du unser Marketing weiter, mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum und der Perspektive, langfristig noch mehr Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Deine Aufgaben Von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung – bei uns bist Du mittendrin. E-Mail-Marketing: Eigenverantwortliche Konzeption, Gestaltung, Umsetzung und Optimierung unserer Newsletter und zielgruppenspezifischen E-Mail-Kampagnen Externe Kommunikation: Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Markenkommunikation über Websites, Social Media, Printmedien und weitere Kanäle hinweg HubSpot & Marketing-Automation: Aktive Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung unseres CRM-Systems, Aufbau automatisierter Workflows, Zielgruppensegmentierung und Optimierung digitaler Prozesse Kampagnen & Projekte: Eigenständige Planung, Steuerung und operative Umsetzung vielfältiger Marketingmaßnahmen – von digitalen Kampagnen über Versandaktionen bis hin zu klassischen Werbemitteln Content & Design: Erstellung überzeugender Inhalte sowie Gestaltung von Grafiken, Präsentationen und Kommunikationsmitteln mit der Adobe Creative Cloud Eventmarketing: Aktive Mitgestaltung unseres unitex-FashionFestivals – von der Vermarktung und Ausstellerkommunikation bis zur Koordination und Umsetzung einer Messe Analyse & Optimierung: Auswertung relevanter KPIs, Identifikation von Potenzialen und Umsetzung konkreter Verbesserungen Weiterentwicklung: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Marketingleitung, Einbringen eigener Ideen und schrittweise Übernahme übergreifender Verantwortung Das bringst Du mit Du denkst mit, packst an und bringst Dinge ins Ziel. Fundierte Praxiserfahrung im Marketing – ob durch Studium, Ausbildung oder einen anderen beruflichen Weg. Entscheidend ist, was Du kannst und daraus machst. Erfahrung im E-Mail-Marketing und ein gutes Verständnis für zielgruppengerechte externe Kommunikation Erfahrung mit CRM-Systemen, idealerweise HubSpot, sowie Begeisterung für Marketing-Automation und digitale Prozesse Ein gutes Gespür für Gestaltung, Sprache und zielgruppengerechte Inhalte sowie die Bereitschaft, Dich in neue Tools einzuarbeiten Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise, Organisationstalent und Entscheidungsfreude Echte Hands-on-Mentalität: Du kannst große Projekte koordinieren, hast aber genauso Freude daran, selbst ins Detail zu gehen und Dinge umzusetzen. Eigeninitiative, Teamgeist und Lust auf ein vielseitiges Marketingumfeld, in dem nicht jeder Tag gleich aussieht Motivation, Dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln und perspektivisch zusätzliche Verantwortung zu übernehmen Das erwartet Dich bei uns Vielseitigkeit statt Schubladendenken. Gestaltungsspielraum statt langer Abstimmungswege. Marketing in seiner ganzen Bandbreite: Bei uns wird nicht nur geplant oder an Agenturen delegiert. Wir entwickeln, gestalten, organisieren und realisieren unsere Marketingmaßnahmen selbst – digital, analog und live. Verantwortung von Anfang an: Du betreust eigene Projekte, bringst Ideen ein und hast die Freiheit, Entscheidungen zu treffen und Dinge voranzubringen. Projekte mit echter Sichtbarkeit: Von unseren regelmäßigen Newslettern und dem unitex-FashionBook bis zum unitex-FashionFestival mit mehreren Tausend Besuchern. Reizen maar! Maar achter die ‘bliep’ gaat een complexe wereld schuil. Welkom in de wereld van Translink! Met de introductie van nieuwe betaalmogelijkheden onder de vlag OVpay is Translink dichter komen te staan bij de bredere financiële sector. In- en uitchecken met de bankpas vereist goede afstemming met banken. Maar ook de bredere inzet van EMV-technologie met OVpay maakt dat we als bedrijf te maken hebben met bestaande card schemes. Daarbij begrijp je niet alleen de commerciële kant van partnerships, maar ook hoe de paymentketen inhoudelijk werkt. Je volgt ontwikkelingen binnen het internationale betalingsverkeer, scheme rules en marktstandaarden en vertaalt deze naar impact en concrete acties voor Translink. Je voert inhoudelijke en commerciële onderhandelingen over voorwaarden, kosten, dienstverlening en gezamenlijke verbeterinitiatieven. Je zorgt voor afstemming tussen Product, Finance, Risk, Legal, Operations, IT en externe partners bij complexe trajecten rondom payments en scheme compliance. Je draagt bij aan de verdere professionalisering en mogelijke organisatorische ontwikkeling van de paymentactiviteiten binnen Translink. WIE ZOEKEN WE? We zoeken een ervaren paymentprofessional die zijn of haar sporen in de sector heeft verdiend. Je begrijpt hoe banken, issuers, acquirers en card schemes met elkaar samenwerken en weet wat er nodig is om binnen dat complexe speelveld duurzame partnerships op te bouwen. Je voelt je comfortabel aan tafel met senior stakeholders en bestuurders. Je bouwt niet alleen relaties, maar zorgt ook dat afspraken daadwerkelijk leiden tot resultaat. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role:

In Token Factory analytics there is no split into product analysts, ML engineers and data engineers. Each person owns a question end to end: builds the data, runs the analysis, and comes back with a recommendation that changes a decision.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Define core product and business metrics and build a single source of truth that Product, Finance, and Sales can rely on.
- Build a comprehensive view of self-service customers, including usage patterns, customer health, satisfaction, retention risks, unmet needs, and growth opportunities.
- Translate customer demand and commercial plans into capacity forecasts and support capacity allocation decisions.
- Measure effective capacity utilization and identify opportunities to improve the commercial value of available capacity.
- Develop and evaluate pricing and packaging models, including guaranteed capacity, on-demand pricing, commitments, clawback mechanisms, and provisioned throughput units.
- Provide data-driven recommendations for the self-service and managed offerings, including customer segmentation, pricing, and capacity.
- Partner with Product, Engineering, Applied AI, Finance, and Sales to turn insights into concrete product and operational improvements.

We expect you to have:

- 5+ years of experience in analytics or data science.
- Strong Python, SQL, and statistics: you understand the code and the methods you use.
- Hands-on experience analysing large-scale customer, product, and usage datasets using statistical / analytical or distributed data-processing tools.
- AI-assisted coding as your default way of working: you guide it, verify it, and own the result.
- The ability to go from a question to a production-ready solution.
- The ability to turn complex data into clear recommendations.
- Strong commercial and product judgment, with the ability to balance customer value, monetization, growth, and profitability.
- Experience with pricing, packaging, monetization, or commercial analytics for technical or consumption-based products.
- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills across Product, Engineering, Data, Finance, Sales, and Operations.
- A hands-on and proactive working style, with the ability to operate effectively in an ambiguous and technically complex environment.

Nice to have:

- Familiarity with LLM inference economics: tokens, throughput and latency, batching, GPU costs.

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. As the Product Manager for Application Observability (App O11y), you’ll be responsible for helping application developers and SREs understand how their applications are performing, what’s affecting their users, and where to focus when something goes wrong. You’ll continue to build App O11y on top of the Knowledge Graph and fully integrate high-fidelity signals like traces and profiles, making all three first-class parts of the product experience. You’ll bring these capabilities together into our full-stack observability experience, alongside our Drilldown products, while building AI-first workflows that help customers investigate issues, understand root cause, and take action beyond static experiences. 

Your primary responsibility will be to define the vision and roadmap that takes App O11y into its next wave of adoption and revenue growth. This will require heavy customer discovery, using product data to understand where users get stuck, and working with your engineering and design partners to turn those needs into clear priorities. You’ll balance new product opportunities with the depth, performance, and reliability customers need from tracing and profiling, while working across R&D to ensure App O11y is tightly woven into our broader Grafana Cloud suite.

You’ll also work closely with PMM and GTM to help customers understand the value of App O11y. This includes shaping pricing and packaging that make it easy to get started and grow with the product. You’ll regularly review customer feedback and usage data to understand what’s working and where people get stuck, and then be accountable for turning what you learn into stronger adoption and revenue growth.

  • Work closely with PMM to enable GTM on product differentiation, including creating and updating presentations, documentation, website content, datasheets, and whitepapers.

  • Systems-Level Thinking: Ability to reason about how a decision at one pipeline stage — what data is collected — affects outcomes at another, such as model performance or evaluation results, and to design across those boundaries.

Beneficial Skills

  • Data Valuation Techniques: Familiarity with active learning, coreset selection, influence functions, or other methods for quantifying training data value.

  • Data Systems: Experience designing and operating large-scale data pipelines — collection, storage, processing, labeling — for machine learning training.
  • Deployment & MLOps: Experience with model serving, edge or real-time inference, or cloud-based deployment infrastructure.

description: Niet faciliteren om te faciliteren. Maar teams helpen slimmer samen te werken. AI verandert de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen. Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We bouwen aan moderne software, slimme dataplatformen en agentic oplossingen. Tegelijkertijd kijken we hoe AI onze eigen manier van werken verandert. Daarom zoeken we een Scrum Master die verder kijkt dan Scrum events. Wat betekent AI voor de manier waarop teams software ontwikkelen? Hoe kunnen AI-developmenttools en agentic workflows bijdragen aan kwaliteit, snelheid en samenwerking? Interesse in AI, automatisering en de veranderende wereld van software engineering. Het vermogen om teams, product owners te coachen, stakeholders uit te dagen en verandering te begeleiden. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels. Ervaring met SAFe, LeSS of andere scaling frameworks is een pré. Je hoeft geen AI-expert te zijn. We zoeken vooral iemand die nieuwsgierig is naar de impact van AI op samenwerking en softwareontwikkeling en teams daarin kan meenemen. Het team Je komt terecht in een team van zo’n 25 gedreven medior en senior developers. We zijn groot genoeg om serieuze projecten neer te zetten en klein genoeg om elkaar te kennen. Iedereen heeft invloed en goede ideeën worden niet alleen gehoord, maar ook uitgeprobeerd. We zetten onze development expertise in bij gerenommeerde bedrijven in Nederland. Daar bouwen we met Java en Kotlin aan oplossingen die ertoe doen, en we gebruiken AI om tot de best mogelijke resultaten te komen. We onderzoeken continu hoe AI ons werk en dat van onze klanten slimmer kan maken. Ontwikkeling staat voorop. Tijdens onze kennisavonden delen we wat we leren en we bezoeken jaarlijks (inter)nationale conferenties om scherp te blijven. Daarnaast spreken we regelmatig af voor informele activiteiten, want goed samenwerken begint met elkaar écht kennen. Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen. Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt. We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen. AI First: samen bouwen aan de toekomst Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We geloven dat AI de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen, met data werken en klanten helpen fundamenteel verandert. Daarom kijken we verder dan losse AI-experimenten. We bouwen aan slimme dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die écht onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen. Dat betekent ook dat we onze eigen manier van werken blijven vernieuwen. We omarmen nieuwe technologie, maar blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop. En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren. Wat krijg je van ons? description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a (Senior/Staff) Platform Engineer based in France. In this role, you will take ownership of a critical cloud infrastructure platform, ensuring the reliability, security, and scalability of services supporting enterprise customers. You will design, build, and continuously improve the systems and tools that empower engineering teams to develop and deploy software efficiently. Working across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, networking, automation, and observability, you will help establish robust engineering foundations while simplifying everyday development workflows. You will also play a key role in incident management, infrastructure security, and the adoption of AI-powered engineering tools. Joining a remote-first, fast-moving environment, you will have significant autonomy and influence over technical decisions and platform strategy. This is an opportunity to shape infrastructure within an ambitious technology business operating in a demanding, security-conscious environment. Accountabilities: Own, maintain, and continuously evolve the cloud infrastructure platform, covering AWS, Kubernetes, networking, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, and observability. Design and implement scalable, reliable, and secure infrastructure solutions that support enterprise-level requirements for availability, auditability, and performance. Improve the developer experience by optimizing engineering workflows, including local development environments, preview environments, and deployment processes. Establish streamlined development and delivery practices that enable engineers to ship software quickly without compromising reliability or security. Lead incident response activities, coordinate troubleshooting efforts, identify root causes, and implement sustainable solutions to prevent recurring issues. Identify repetitive manual processes and transform them into automated workflows, self-service tools, and efficient infrastructure operations. Support the safe adoption of AI agents within engineering workflows by developing appropriate sandbox environments, security controls, and operational guardrails. Drive continuous improvements across platform reliability, infrastructure security, monitoring, and operational efficiency. Collaborate closely with software engineers and other technical stakeholders to understand infrastructure needs, communicate architectural decisions, and deliver effective platform solutions. Take ownership of technical challenges from identification through implementation, ensuring that infrastructure decisions support long-term business and engineering objectives. Requirements: Significant professional experience in platform engineering, DevOps, site reliability engineering (SRE), cloud infrastructure, or a closely related technical discipline, at Senior or Staff level. Strong hands-on expertise in production cloud infrastructure, particularly Kubernetes, cloud networking, and infrastructure as code. Practical experience designing, deploying, and operating infrastructure in production environments, with a strong understanding of reliability, scalability, and security principles. Proficiency with infrastructure automation and modern deployment practices, including tools and technologies such as Terraform and CI/CD pipelines. Experience improving developer experience and engineering productivity through better tooling, automation, and streamlined development workflows is a strong advantage. Knowledge of observability, monitoring, incident management, and infrastructure security, with the ability to identify and address operational risks. Previous experience working in a startup or scale-up environment, demonstrating the ability to take ownership of complex problems and deliver solutions independently. Strong technical judgment and decision-making skills, with the confidence to challenge existing approaches, explain trade-offs clearly, and advocate for effective engineering practices. Adaptability and curiosity when working with different cloud providers, technologies, and tools, with a strong willingness to learn new systems and approaches. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, combined with a proactive, autonomous, and solutions-oriented mindset. Experience working in regulated industries such as fintech, payments, or digital identity is considered a plus. Familiarity with AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Node.js, TypeScript, or event-driven architectures is beneficial, although expertise across the entire technology stack is not required. Interest in emerging AI-powered engineering tools and the ability to approach their adoption with a strong focus on security and operational best practices. Curiosity, authenticity, kindness, and a collaborative attitude, with a genuine passion for building high-quality products and infrastructure. Benefits: Full-time employment opportunity within a remote-first working environment. Location flexibility, with remote opportunities across Europe. Opportunity to work on critical infrastructure supporting enterprise customers with demanding reliability, security, and compliance requirements. Significant ownership and autonomy over platform architecture, infrastructure strategy, and technical decisions. Opportunity to shape engineering practices, developer experience, and deployment workflows across the organization. Exposure to modern cloud-native technologies, including AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, and AI-powered engineering tools. Opportunity to contribute to the safe and effective adoption of emerging AI technologies. Collaborative environment focused on transparency, ambition, continuous learning, and high-quality engineering. Opportunity to work alongside an experienced team supported by leading international investors and industry experts. Inclusive culture that values diverse professional backgrounds, curiosity, authenticity, and kindness. Encouragement to apply even if you do not meet every listed requirement, with an emphasis on potential, technical depth, and willingness to learn. description:
Orcrist is building a next generation data intelligence platform using cutting-edge technologies. We're handling petabyte-scale data with sub-second queries. Our product is a Kubernetes‑based platform delivered as B2B SaaS or as a self‑hosted on‑prem solution, including air‑gapped deployments. We enable customers across defense, law enforcement, and enterprise to turn mission-critical data into actionable intelligence.

Role

We're looking for a hands-on Solution Architect to join our GovDev team. You are the technical counterpart to our customers in the public sector, defence and intelligence space: you run the technical dialogue with incoming leads, turn their requirements into
working prototypes on our platform, and hand what survives over to Product & Engineering in a state they can build on.

This is not a pre-sales or slideware role. Roughly half of your time you build: integrating customer data sources into our platform, wiring up pipelines on our data fabric (ODFF), and shipping demo-grade frontends. The other half you spend with customers and our product teams, making sure what we promise is what the platform can do, and what the platform can't do yet lands on the roadmap.

What you'll do

  • Act as technical lead on incoming opportunities: run discovery calls, qualify technical fit against the platform's current state, answer architecture, integration and security
    questions, and own the technical part of pitches, demos and workshops.
  • Build prototypes yourself: ingest a customer's data (files, APIs, message exports, sensor feeds, geodata) through our ingest layer, model it into our universal record and
    entity schema, and expose it in the platform frontend or a purpose-built demo UI.
  • Design integration architectures for customer environments: on-premise and air-gapped Kubernetes deployments, identity (OIDC/Keycloak, Kerberos/Ranger), connections to legacy systems and interfaces common in government and military IT.
  • Lead technical deep dives with customer architects and IT security: platform architecture, data flow, lineage, classification handling, deployment options.
  • Hand over won opportunities to the owning Product & Engineering team: architecture decision records, integration docs, data model, open gaps, customer context. 
  • Feed platform gaps and friction found during prototyping back to the product teams as concrete tickets and RFC input.
  • Represent the voice of the market to Product: cluster recurring requirements across leads and bring them into roadmap and OKR discussions.
  • Maintain reusable demo assets: reference prototypes, scenario data sets, architecture diagrams, integration guides, technical FAQ.

About you

  • 5+ years in software or data engineering, of which at least 1-2 in a customer-facing technical role (like solution architect, forward deployed engineer, technical consultant with delivery responsibility).
  • You write production-quality code today, in Python and TypeScript or a comparable combination, and can show prototypes or systems you built end to end.
  • Hands-on experience with distributed data pipelines (Spark, Kafka or equivalent) and with integrating heterogeneous data sources: files, APIs, databases, message streams.
  • Experience deploying and operating software on Kubernetes, including on-premise or restricted environments.
  • Comfortable leading technical discussions with customer architects, IT security and executives, in German and in English (C1+).
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% (national and international) 
  • Authorization to work in Germany

What we offer

  • Remote-first, Germany-wide: Work from wherever you do your best work, with regular team gatherings in Berlin and other off-site locations.
  • Flexibility by default: Flexible working hours help you make work fit your life.
  • Your setup, your way: Get a personal home-office equipment budget to create a workspace that works for you.
  • 30 days of vacation: Take the time you need to recharge and come back with fresh energy.
  • Keep growing: We invest in your personal and professional development.
  • Get rewarded for impact: Performance bonuses are tied to agreed objectives and key results.
  • A warm welcome: Every new team member gets a welcome goodie bag.
  • Good people, good times: From summer and Christmas parties to regular team gatherings, we make time to celebrate together.
  • A mission that matters: Work on challenges with tangible impact on public safety and national security.

Drive technical implementation excellence: Define, document, and champion technical solution consulting best practices, raising the technical bar and driving consistency across all implementations. Become a Multi-ERP expert: Leverage your existing SAP, P2P, and module expertise (MM/FI) to build deep fluency across additional ERP ecosystems, ultimately becoming the ultimate subject matter expert on integration architecture, data models, and Zip’s App Studio. Build for permanent scale: Approach every technical challenge with an engineering mindset - designing and executing a solution thoroughly once so that future implementations happen effortlessly. Experience working with XML / REST based endpoints and standard authentication protocols. Past ERP implementation, integration, configuration or administration experience is required. Ability to translate highly technical information for audiences with varying degrees of technical knowledge. Comfortable working with API documentation. Comfortable testing and troubleshooting integration errors. Able to understand customer requirements and document that information quickly, with little oversight A continual learner and open to learning new technologies that Zip may integrate with in the future. description: LA MAISON Jacquemus a été fondé par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France. Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l’art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture. Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l’appartement parisien d’Auguste Perret (La Croisière). Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d’ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street) et Dubai. VOTRE RÔLE En tant que Conseiller(ère) de vente, vous serez ambassadeur / ambassadrice de la Maison et vous jouerez un rôle essentiel afin d’offrir à chaque client une expérience unique dans le respect et l’engagement de la Maison Jacquemus. Vous vous efforcerez de découvrir la personnalité de vos clients et d'identifier leurs désirs, tout en leur faisant découvrir l’ADN de la Maison et tous les univers produits. VOS MISSIONS · Participer activement au développement du chiffre d’affaires en accompagnant l’équipe dans l’atteinte des objectifs du point de vente. · Accueillir et conseiller nos clients pour leur offrir une expérience exceptionnelle. · Découvrir et partager votre expertise sur nos produits auprès des clients. · Faire preuve de proactivité en suggérant des produits complémentaires. · Contribuer à la fidélisation de notre clientèle en développant des relations privilégiées. · Assurer la bonne tenue du point de vente en collaboration avec l’équipe. · Participer aux missions opérationnelles : Visual merchandising, réassort, gestion des stocks, SAV. · Appliquer et respecter les procédures internes et guidelines. · Représenter l’esprit Jacquemus à travers votre créativité et votre sens de l’excellence. PROFIL · Étudiant(e) en école de commerce, de mode ou de management, avec une forte sensibilité pour l’univers de la mode et du luxe. · Première expérience en vente ou relation client appréciée. · Excellentes capacités de communication et sens du service client. · Enthousiaste, curieux(se) et doté(e) d’un esprit d’initiative. · Adaptable et proactif(ve), avec un fort esprit d’équipe. · Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, une troisième langue serait un plus. description: Hé stage topper! Kom jij, net als vele andere stagiaires, stagelopen bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo? Bij ons krijg jij de kans om mee te denken, werken én ontwikkelen aan gave projecten binnen Noord, Midden en Oost-Nederland. Wij hebben weer volop stageplekken vanaf Februari 2027 op onze bouwen en op kantoor! Dit wordt jouw stage Als stagiair bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo ga je aan de slag op ons kantoor of op één van onze projecten. We kijken in overeenstemming welke afdeling of welk project het beste bij jou en/of de opdracht past. Tijdens je stage word je goed begeleid door één van onze collega’s en krijg je de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen! Jij staat aan het stuur van je eigen ontwikkeling tijdens je stageperiode: Hoe meer jij wil leren, hoe meer jij kan leren! Naast dat je zelfstandig aan een opdracht kan werken wordt je ook begeleidt door een senior collega die jou alle kneepjes van het vak gaat leren. We hebben door heel ons werkgebied verschillende bouwen waar we ruimte hebben voor een stagiaire, stuur ons vooral een berichtje zodat we samen kunnen kijken wat passend is! Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een familiebedrijf. Een onafhankelijke bouwonderneming actief in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek in Nederland. Al sinds 1855 vormen onze onafhankelijkheid en langjarige continuïteit de basis voor onze strategie. Met een omzet van circa € 1,8 miljard en ruim 3.000 medewerkers behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Samen realiseren we prachtige projecten. Iconische, en soms ook alledaagse projecten waarmee we nieuwe antwoorden bieden op maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Waarmee we de beste oplossingen voor morgen garanderen en het verschil maken voor Nederland, juist op de langere termijn. We hebben stevige ambities – en daarvoor geldt dat we die alleen kunnen waarmaken dankzij onze mensen. Als beste werkgever maken wij ons er daarom hard voor dat jij elke dag opnieuw kiest voor Dura Vermeer. Dat jij net zo trots bent op wat we maken als wij dat zijn. Dat iedereen die bij ons werkt gelukkig is. Dat je bij ons jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je kunt uitspreken. En dat je tot je recht komt. En het beste uit jezelf kunt halen. Hier zit je goed! Wij zijn Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo, een ontwikkelende bouwer in het werkgebied Noord-, Oost- en Midden-Nederland. Als onderdeel van de divisie Bouw & Vastgoed combineren we de kracht van een groot bedrijf, met de fijne sfeer en cultuur van een kleinere organisatie. Bij ons vind je echte doeners en waarmakers. We ontwikkelen en bouwen, samen met onze klanten, partners en collega’s. Wat ons ons maakt? Gewoon dóen en gewóón doen. Dat zit er nou eenmaal in, en zie je terug in alles wat we doen. Wil jij nou werken op een plek waar vakmanschap, samenwerking en heel veel plezier samenkomen? Mooi! You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. Checkout.com is actively looking for an enthusiastic and talented Strategic Accounts, Senior Business Developer to join us as we accelerate our Enterprise development of Global Accounts from our offices in London. This is a fantastic opportunity to play a fundamental role in our rapid growth as we revolutionise merchant experience and continue to set ourselves apart from the rest when managing our largest and most strategic accounts worldwide. If you are a motivated and focused individual, with high attention to detail and a relentless drive for growth and excellence, this is the role for you. We are looking for a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced and competitive environment and is excited about joining us at this pivotal point in our journey. This role will be part of our Strategic Accounts team and sits within our Commercial department. You will have the opportunity to work cross-functionally with teams across Sales, Enablement, Product, Marketing, Solutions Engineering and more. The ideal candidate approaches enterprise business development and intelligence in an analytical manner, is data-driven, and is a creative problem-solver What you will do: Develop and own the strategic account plans and end-to-end deal progression strategy for a portfolio of key prospects in collaboration with Enterprise Sales Representatives. Serve as the internal Methodology expert and trusted advisor on the key strategic accounts, including their industry, market trends, and critical business challenges. Conduct in-depth market and account analysis (organisational structure, strategic priorities, competitive landscape) to generate actionable insights that accelerate sales cycles and inform business strategy. Proactively leverage AI-driven systems (e.g., Salesforce, 6Sense, proprietary tools) and advanced analytics to optimise lead generation, strategic planning, and pipeline accuracy. Work closely with Sales in nurturing, developing, and deepening relationships with existing and prospective merchants. Influence cross-functional teams of stakeholders (including Product, Solutions Engineering, and Legal) to ensure an aligned team effort when dealing and onboarding with key merchants. Assist senior leadership in shaping tailored solutions and product offerings for each merchant. Collaborate daily with our engagement team to ensure a strong understanding and alignment across the entire sales cycle. About You: Relevant experience in Enterprise Sales Development, Strategic Account Management, or Consultative B2B Sales, preferably in payments, fintech, banking, or financial services. Proven ability to build and sustain deep, multi-threaded relationships with multiple stakeholders up to the C-suite level within a large enterprise environment. Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience using data/CRM (e.g., Salesforce) for account mapping, opportunity identification, and accurate forecasting. Exceptional written and verbal communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex financial/technical value propositions to senior stakeholders. Highly organised and able to prioritise shifting workloads and responsibilities effectively. Eager to understand and navigate long sales cycles. Commercially minded and possesses a deep understanding of issues large accounts are facing. AI savvy user of enterprise tools and technologies. Fluent in English (other languages are a plus) Additional Information Bring all of you to work We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one. Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands. We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here. It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable. Life at Checkout.com We understand that work is just one part of your life. Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us. description:
ABOUT NEXGEN CLOUD

NexGen Cloud is a fast-growing GPU cloud and AI infrastructure business. We’re the company behind Hyperstack — a self-serve, on-demand cloud platform built for high-performance AI, HPC, and compute-heavy workloads. Powered by 100% renewable energy and NVIDIA architecture, Hyperstack gives teams from AI startups to enterprise the compute they need, without the cost or complexity of legacy cloud.

We move fast, solve hard problems, and build things that matter. If you want ownership, real impact, and a front-row seat to one of the most consequential infrastructure shifts of the decade — this is the place.

THE ROLE: VP OF DATA CENTRE STRATEGY

Everything we sell depends on having the right power, in the right place, at the right time. Until now, decisions about where we build, who we partner with and how we secure capacity have been spread across the business. This new role brings them under one owner: someone who sets NexGen’s global data centre strategy and makes sure capacity is there before customers need it.

This is a senior individual contributor role, and it covers both strategy and execution. One day you’re taking a site recommendation to the executive team. The next you’re across the table from a colocation operator negotiating a multi-year contract. We plan to build a dedicated development function over time. Until then, you’ll do more of the hands-on delivery work yourself, and you’ll help decide when that team gets built.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Rather than a checklist, here’s what success in this role actually looks like:
- Build and own NexGen’s global data centre strategy and the 12–36 month capacity roadmap, so capacity is never the reason we miss a customer commitment
- Decide which markets and regions we expand into, set the criteria for choosing sites, and build a pipeline of data centre opportunities against them
- Make the call on colocation vs. owned infrastructure, and own the investment case for each site
- Secure reliable, cost-effective power for GPU-dense workloads, in line with our 100% renewable commitment, and spot grid and capacity constraints before they hit customers
- Lead the big negotiations on colocation agreements, power contracts and strategic vendor deals, and hold partners to their SLAs
- Set NexGen’s position on data sovereignty and planning across jurisdictions, and deal with regulators and government directly when the stakes are high
- Bring cost per MW and cost per GPU rack down, and make sure capex goes where the commercial pipeline needs it

ABOUT YOU

We care more about how you think and work than a perfect CV. You’ll likely bring a combination of the following:

Essential:
- 10+ years in data centre infrastructure, with significant time in a senior strategy, development or commercial role
- A proven track record in site selection, colocation negotiation and data centre partner management at scale
- A deep understanding of power procurement and capacity planning, and of the commercial side of running GPU-dense AI infrastructure
- Experience negotiating complex, multi-year contracts with data centre operators and vendors
- An established network across the colocation ecosystem, plus experience at or with neoclouds, hyperscalers or GPU infrastructure platforms

Nice to Have:
- Power procurement for high-density compute specifically, rather than general enterprise space
- Grid connection, sovereign cloud or government engagement in more than one jurisdiction
- Existing relationships with renewable power providers or experience structuring PPAs
- Experience growing an infrastructure function from a standalone role into a team, including deciding when to bring in dedicated delivery capability

WHAT WE OFFER

- Competitive salary and annual discretionary bonus scheme
- Employee wellbeing benefits
- 25 days holiday, plus public holidays
- Private Medical Insurance
- Enhanced Pension Scheme
- Flexible working arrangements (remote or hybrid, depending on role and location)
- Real ownership and autonomy — the trust to take initiative and experiment
- Visible, meaningful impact as we scale
- Clear career progression in a high-growth company
- A collaborative, international culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership
- The chance to help shape NexGen Cloud’s team, culture, and future

WHY APPLY

We welcome applications from all backgrounds. If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure problems and want to build something meaningful at scale, we’d like to hear from you.

MORE INFORMATION

Visit our careers page to learn more about us or follow us on LinkedIn and X to learn more about our journey and keep up with our latest news and releases.

Design neural network parameters, trained on large quantities of unlabeled text data. Must have skills : Snowflake Data Warehouse Good to have skills : Microsoft Azure Data Services, Data Science Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary: AI Powered Tech Talent You are a a strong individual contributor knowledge engineer growing into a team lead. You are well versed in the full knowledge graph development lifecycle. You formulate real-world problems into practical, efficient, scalable AI and Knowledge Graph solutions, working hands-on across the lifecycle from ingestion through modeling, curation, and deployment. You apply current methodologies, techniques, and algorithms with the right architecture, and begin to guide junior engineers on the project. You stay current with knowledge engineering, generative AI, LLM, and multi-modal models look for opportunities to apply them to the problem at hand. Build Knowledge Graph components that contribute to transforming a client's data architecture. Design, develop, and implement AI and semantic solutions ensure their work integrates cleanly with the broader system. Work alongside the project team and delivery leads. Support Accenture sales efforts when called on. Keep developing skills in cutting-edge Data & AI solutions, especially agentic technologies, and shares with the team. You have team lead experience Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work across engineering, research, and product teams across multiple time zones. title: Knowledge Engineering Manager

description: We Are: Accenture is a global professional services and solutions company that helps leading organizations reinvent with digital, cloud, data, and AI capabilities, drawing on its large global workforce, industry expertise, and ecosystem partnerships to create 360° value. By combining hands-on engineering with deep industry context, we help organizations build their digital core, modernize operations, unlock value from data and AI, and deliver tangible business outcomes at speed and scale. Role Summary: We are looking for a Back-End Engineer to design, build, and operate the data infrastructure and services that power our AI-driven knowledge platform. You will work across the full back-end stack — architecting APIs, building data pipelines, managing multi-modal database systems, and owning the reliability and performance of the services that application and product teams depend on. You bring strong engineering fundamentals and are equally comfortable designing a relational schema, tuning a graph query, standing up a vector store, or shipping a production-grade REST API. Knowledge graph and semantic technology experience is central to this role, but the work extends across the broader data and service layer: ingestion, transformation, storage, retrieval, and delivery at enterprise scale. You Are: We are looking for a Back-End Engineer to design, build, and operate the data infrastructure and services that power our AI-driven knowledge platform. You will work across the full back-end stack — architecting APIs, building data pipelines, managing multi-modal database systems, and owning the reliability and performance of the services that application and product teams depend on. You bring strong engineering fundamentals and are equally comfortable designing a relational schema, tuning a graph query, standing up a vector store, or shipping a production-grade REST API. Knowledge graph and semantic technology experience is central to this role, but the work extends across the broader data and service layer: ingestion, transformation, storage, retrieval, and delivery at enterprise scale. Key Responsibilities: Hydrate structured and semi-structured data into Knowledge Graphs by mapping source data to ontology models. Develop data mapping and transformation workflows using R2RML or similar technologies. Write and optimize SPARQL queries for graph loading, validation, and retrieval. Build and maintain data ingestion pipelines and integrate data from enterprise systems. Design and optimize relational database schemas and queries to support efficient graph hydration and ETL workflows. Deploy, configure, and maintain vector database infrastructure for embedding storage, indexing, and semantic retrieval at scale. Design and maintain scalable graph query APIs consumed by internal application and product teams. Performance-tune graph database queries, indexing strategies, and data access patterns. Own containerization, deployment, and monitoring of graph services in cloud environments. Ensure data quality, ontology alignment, and secure handling of sensitive data (PII/PHI). Collaborate with ontologists, architects, and application teams to support Knowledge Graph implementations. Preferred Technology Stack: Semantic technologies: RDF, OWL, SKOS, RDFS Query languages: SPARQL Mapping technologies: R2RML, CSVW, SHACL (preferred) Graph databases: GraphDB, Stardog, Neo4j, Amazon Neptune Relational databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server Vector stores: Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, Qdrant Search: Elasticsearch / OpenSearch Programming: Python, Java (preferred) Data formats: SQL, JSON, XML, CSV Integration: REST APIs, ETL tools, Apache NiFi, Airflow (preferred) Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm Cloud: AWS Neptune, Azure Cosmos DB, GCP Messaging: Kafka, RabbitMQ Version control: Git This role is hybrid in nature and will require time in office and traveling to client locations. Travel can be between 20-80% Here's What You Need: Minimum 5 years experience in Knowledge Graph data hydration and ontology-based data mapping, including strong understanding of RDF, SPARQL, and semantic technologies. Minimum 5 years experience with R2RML or similar mapping frameworks for transforming relational data into graph models. Minimum 5 years experience with graph databases (e.g., StarDog, GraphWise, Neo4J), along with Elasticsearch/OpenSearch. including strong SQL proficiency. Minimum 5 years hands-on experience with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server), including schema design, indexing, and query optimization. Minimum 5 years experience deploying and operating vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, or Qdrant) in production environments. Minimum 5 years Proficiency in Python or Java for automation, integration, and service development and experience designing and documenting REST APIs for internal consumers. Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience Bonus Points if You Have: Familiarity with containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes). Knowledge of data ingestion pipelines, ETL/integration, and enterprise system integration. Understanding of PII/PHI handling, data anonymization, and data governance. Design and build user-facing applications and dashboards that surface Knowledge Graph data to end users. Develop and maintain REST and GraphQL APIs bridging graph backends and frontend clients. Experience with graph visualization libraries (D3.js, Cytoscape.js). Familiarity with a BFF (Backend for Frontend) or API gateway pattern. Experience with AI agent-driven pipelines or RAG architectures. Understanding of Federated Knowledge Graph architectures. Experience working across Development, Test, UAT, and Production environments. Cloud platform experience (AWS Neptune, Azure Cosmos DB, or GCP). Experience with event-driven architectures and message queuing (Kafka, RabbitMQ). Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, Helm). Experience with database replication, partitioning, and high-availability patterns for relational systems. Familiarity with vector embedding pipelines and strategies for chunking, re-ranking, and retrieval optimization. description: We are: The Advanced Technology Centers (ATCs) are the engine for reinvention in our clients’ transformation journey. Powered by more than 255,000 people across 24 countries, ATCs provide our clients with seamless access to industry insights and innovative technology solutions. Stronger together! The Advanced Technology Centers (ATCs) make a tremendous impact in solving our clients’ business problems by leveraging innovation, intelligence, industry insights, new IT, and new technology skills. With the global environment changing at a faster pace, our clients are facing unprecedented challenges, and they need us more than ever before. As a Network, ATCs are positioned to unlock greater opportunities and exponential value for our clients. The value for our clients and our people: For our clients, the Network provides the strength of our geographic diversity, greater resilience, and seamless access to the deepest industry knowledge, the latest in Gen AI solutions, and tech expertise from around the world. For our people, it brings an opportunity to shape truly boundaryless career paths in a highly collaborative team of experts where they can learn from each other and solve the world’s most complex client challenges. You Are You are a Knowledge Architect at the intersection of semantic AI and agentic systems — shaping the knowledge backbone of AI platforms by designing the ontologies, graphs, and data models that enable intelligent agents to reason, plan, and act. You are equally comfortable whiteboarding an ontology with a domain expert and pushing graph schemas to production alongside an ML team. You see the world as a graph, and you believe that well-structured knowledge is the foundation of truly intelligent machines. You thrive on translating complex, messy real-world knowledge into clean, reasoned, machine-readable structures that AI agents can act on — and you bring the rigor, curiosity, and collaboration to do it at scale. The Work You will embed directly with clients as a trusted technology advisor and hands-on engineer — leading the architecture and development of knowledge graphs, ontologies, and semantic data models that power next-generation agentic AI systems at enterprise scale. Responsabilities Own the end-to-end design, governance, and maintenance of enterprise-scale knowledge graphs and ontologies, bridging structured domain knowledge with large-scale agentic AI pipelines to enable reasoning, planning, and decision-making. Develop and govern ontologies, taxonomies, and semantic data models that formalize domain knowledge and support interoperability across systems and teams. Define and enforce data modeling standards, schema design patterns, and best practices for structured and semi-structured knowledge representation. Translate complex domain knowledge from subject matter experts into formal, machine-readable knowledge structures using RDF, OWL, SPARQL, or property graph models. Lead knowledge engineering discovery workshops and working sessions with client stakeholders to surface, validate, and formalize domain knowledge requirements. Collaborate with AI/ML engineers to integrate knowledge graphs as grounding and context layers for LLM-based agentic pipelines and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems. Design knowledge structures that support multi-step agent reasoning, tool use, and dynamic planning across heterogeneous data sources. Work with project teams, team leaders, delivery leads, and client stakeholders to create standout Data & AI offerings powered by graph-based technologies. Collaborate with data engineering and platform teams to build scalable pipelines for knowledge graph population, enrichment, and lifecycle management. Develop strong client relationships and earn the trust of key stakeholders as a strategic advisor. Communicate complex ontological concepts and graph architectures clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Evaluate and pilot emerging tools, frameworks, and standards (e.g., LPG vs. RDF, Wikidata, schema.org, W3C standards). Required Skills Knowledge Representation & Ontology Ontology design and engineering (OWL, RDF, RDFS) Taxonomy and thesaurus development Semantic modeling and linked data principles Schema design (schema.org, custom domain schemas) and W3C standards Knowledge Graph Technologies Property graph and RDF graph modeling Graph databases: Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, TigerGraph, Stardog SPARQL, Cypher, and Gremlin query languages Graph traversal, reasoning, inference, entity resolution, and enrichment Agentic AI & LLM Integration Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures LLM grounding and context design using structured knowledge Agentic pipeline design: LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen Prompt engineering for knowledge-intensive, enterprise-scale applications Neuro-symbolic AI concepts and reasoning frameworks Data Modeling & Engineering Conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling Graph schema design and lifecycle management Entity linking, disambiguation, and deduplication Metadata management and data governance Programming & Tooling Python (primary); graph libraries: NetworkX, RDFLib, PyKEEN SPARQL and graph query optimization REST APIs, microservices integration, Git, CI/CD familiarity Cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP Location & Travel This is a hybrid role based in Dallas, TX, requiring 3 days per week in office. Qualified candidates in Columbus, OH; Tampa, FL; Atlanta, GA; and Houston, TX will also be considered. Travel is required and will vary between 25%–75% depending on business need and client requirements. Here´s what you need Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years' work experience). Associate's degree requires minimum 6 years' equivalent work experience. 4+ years of experience in Knowledge Graph technologies (e.g., RDF, SPARQL, Gremlin, LPG, SHACL, RDFS) 2+ years of experience with schema design, ontology management, and Knowledge Graph curation 2+ years of experience in semantic modeling and linked data principles 2+ years of experience designing and developing knowledge graph solutions and graph-based machine learning models 2+ years of experience with relational databases, object stores, graph databases (e.g., Stardog, Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, TigerGraph), and vector databases 2+ years of experience in agentic pipeline design (LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen) Preferred Qualifications 2+ years of hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) 2+ years of experience in Python, with frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, and ETL pipeline tools (e.g., Apache NiFi, Airflow) Practical experience with NLP and/or enterprise search techniques Prompt engineering and LLM experience for enterprise-scale applications Strong cross-functional collaboration skills across engineering, research, and product teams in multiple time zones Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field Broad experience in diverse ML techniques and agentic systems Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. description: About the Centre for Advanced Data APAC The Centre for Advanced Data (C4AD) is Accenture's specialist centre of excellence that sets the architecture standard for modern, AI-ready data estates across APAC, and mobilises the talent to deliver them at scale. The C4AD operates across three core disciplines: Master Data Architecture, Knowledge Engineering, and Data Products. Every practitioner in the C4AD is expected to apply agentic and generative techniques as the default way of working, not as an add-on. The centre supports large-scale data and AI transformation programmes across the region, ranging from enterprise data modernisation to AI-ready platform builds. Job Description Join the Centre for Advanced Data APAC as a Knowledge Engineer, where you will own ontology and semantic strategy across engagements, set the knowledge-engineering standards for the practice, and assure the semantic layers that ground enterprise AI. You will define how the C4AD approaches knowledge representation across programmes, and hold the line on quality, consistency, and semantic integrity as those programmes scale. You will work closely with Data Architects and AI Engineers, ensuring that the ontologies and knowledge graphs you define and govern give AI systems something real, structured, and reliable to reason over. Project Description / Key Responsibilities Own ontology and semantic strategy across C4AD engagements, setting the approach, standards, and quality bar for knowledge engineering across the practice. Assure semantic layers that ground enterprise AI, reviewing, governing, and signing off on the ontological structures that AI systems in our programmes reason over. Design, develop, and govern enterprise ontologies, taxonomies, and knowledge graphs that accurately represent business domains, their relationships, and the rules that govern them. Build and govern semantic models using RDF/OWL, SHACL, and SPARQL, and property graph approaches using platforms such as Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, or Stardog. Apply and adapt industry-standard ontologies (e.g. FIBO, BIAN, GS1, TM Forum) to meet organisation-specific semantic requirements. Develop and enforce semantic modelling standards, naming conventions, versioning, and curation workflows, and drive adoption of those standards across delivery teams. Enable AI and ML applications through knowledge graph enrichment, entity resolution, semantic search, and ontology-powered RAG pipelines. Engage business SMEs and domain experts to elicit and formalise implicit business rules, relationships, and concepts into explicit ontological structures. Key Skills 5+ years of experience in knowledge engineering, ontology design, or semantic modelling, with a track record of owning the knowledge engineering approach on complex programmes, not just contributing to it. Proven deep expertise in ontology engineering, authoring OWL ontologies, RDFS schemas, SHACL constraint shapes, and SPARQL queries, with real enterprise delivery behind it. Hands-on experience with graph databases and knowledge graph platforms such as Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, Stardog, or GraphDB. Proficiency with semantic tooling including Protégé, TopBraid Composer, or equivalent ontology authoring environments. Strong understanding of how semantic models connect to downstream data products, metadata catalogues, and AI/ML enrichment workflows, and the ability to assure that integration is sound. Knowledge of property graph modelling and the ability to move between RDF-based and property graph paradigms depending on platform and use case. Experience with entity resolution, semantic search, and knowledge-driven RAG architectures. Experience working within modern data architectures including data mesh, data lakehouse, and federated governance models. Background in linked data principles (W3C standards) and LLM grounding techniques, including GraphRAG and ontology-grounded generation, and practical experience applying them in enterprise contexts. Industry experience in Financial Services, Government, Health, Energy, or Utilities sectors in APAC is highly regarded. description: UKI Finance RP Finance Data Engineer The practice Finance is one of the most demanding and valuable environments in which to apply modern technology. You will work with complex enterprise data, mission-critical processes and high-impact decisions, using AI, data and engineering to reshape how organisations plan, control performance and allocate resources. The opportunity goes beyond building technically strong solutions: you will see how those solutions influence cash, profitability, risk and business growth, and take them from experimentation into trusted, production-ready capabilities. Working in Finance Reinvention allows you to remain close to leading-edge technology while developing an understanding of the CFO agenda, gaining exposure to senior decision-makers and building the commercial judgement needed to solve enterprise-wide challenges. This combination of deep technical capability, finance-domain expertise and measurable business impact creates a differentiated career path that is difficult to develop in a purely technology-focused role. Purpose of the role Responsible for the finance data and ontology layer on which agentic solutions depend. Builds the entities, relationships, definitions, lineage and data contracts sourced from live ERP and EPM systems to a standard that supports controlled and auditable agent behaviour. The role owns governed finance data products, semantic models and retrieval-ready data services that are secure, permission-aware, observable and suitable for AI, analytics and decision intelligence. Responsibilities Build and extend the finance ontology covering supplier, invoice, customer, receivable, journal, account, cost centre and forecast line, and the relationships between them, including controlled vocabularies, business glossaries, hierarchy history, ownership and lifecycle versioning. Engineer pipelines from SAP, Oracle, Workday and EPM platforms into governed data products, supporting structured and unstructured sources, batch and incremental ingestion, APIs, files and change-data-capture patterns as appropriate. Build entity-resolution and master or reference-data capabilities that reconcile identifiers, definitions and hierarchies across source systems and preserve source-to-target mappings. Establish lineage and evidence sufficient for audit, so that agent output can be traced to source, with automated data-quality checks, finance reconciliations, completeness and freshness measures, observability, alerts and recoverable operations. Define data contracts between delivery pods, and between Accenture delivery and client platform teams, including schemas, quality thresholds, access rules, service levels, versioning and change-control expectations. Experience deploying software or data products on Azure, AWS or GCP, DataBricks, Snowflake, Palantir etc using relevant cloud services and at least one of containers, Kubernetes or serverless patterns. Work with AI Engineers on retrieval and grounding, ensuring models receive appropriately scoped context, including chunking and embedding strategies, hybrid or graph retrieval, permission-aware filtering, provenance and retrieval evaluation. Implement security and privacy controls across the data lifecycle, including role- or attribute-based access, row or document-level permissions, masking or tokenisation, retention, tenant isolation and audit logging. Apply software and DataOps practices including Git, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code where relevant, performance tuning, cost optimisation and production support. Collaborate with finance SMEs, data owners, architects and governance teams to agree definitions, resolve data issues and embed sustainable stewardship and operating ownership. Data engineering Essential experience Production data engineering, including SQL, Python, a modern data platform such as Databricks, Snowflake or Fabric, and orchestration tooling, with practical experience of ETL/ELT, data testing, Git and CI/CD; PySpark or dbt experience is beneficial. Working knowledge of finance data structures, including chart of accounts, entity hierarchy, sub-ledger to ledger relationships, intercompany and period close, together with actual, budget and forecast data, currencies, consolidation and management hierarchies. Strong data modelling discipline and the ability to justify and maintain definitional standards, including canonical or semantic models, data contracts, schema evolution, metadata, lineage and data-quality controls. Experience extracting and reconciling data from enterprise applications or complex operational systems using APIs, files, database interfaces or change-data-capture patterns. Experience deploying software or data products on Azure, AWS or GCP, DataBricks, Snowflake, Palantir etc. using relevant cloud services and at least one of containers, Kubernetes or serverless patterns. (AI engineer – desirable) Understanding of secure data engineering, including access control, encryption, secrets, privacy, retention and the handling of sensitive or regulated data. Ability to work with finance SMEs and technical teams to translate business definitions and controls into implementable data products and acceptance criteria. At least 10 years’ relevant professional experience Knowledge graph, semantic layer or ontology engineering experience, including technologies or standards such as Neo4j, RDF/OWL, SKOS, SPARQL or GraphRAG. Data quality, master data management or lineage tooling experience, including entity resolution, business glossaries, catalogues or platforms such as Collibra, Purview or Unity Catalog. Exposure to SOX or external audit requirements, GDPR, model-risk controls or regulated-data environments. Detailed knowledge of one or more finance-platform data models, such as SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Fusion, Workday Financials, Anaplan, OneStream or SAP Analytics Cloud. Experience evaluating retrieval quality for AI workloads, including embeddings, vector stores, hybrid search or reranking. Architect bitemporal data models (valid-time and transaction-time) to track historical state changes, schema evolution, and ontology versioning.
